scope: Bootstrap/login, authenticated shell, every current route, Phase-3-touched legacy/history routes, shared dialogs/sheets, representative stable/dynamic states, and both authority modes
releaseRule: No criterion may remain Failed or Blocked. Platform screen-reader execution is recorded separately and is never inferred from automation.
statusMeaning: Passed means the criterion has no failure in the declared automated/code-review scope and is backed by the concrete evidence catalog below. It does not mean an unavailable real device, operating system, browser, or screen reader was executed.
assistiveTechnologyStatus: NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, and Orca checks are Not executed in frontend/qa/platform-qa-ledger.json and remain final human/device validation work.

E1.coverage: Four fresh-stack stages, 38 route/state entries, complete critical control loop at six viewports, Chrome/Firefox/WebKit, keyboard/touch, retry, and axe.

E2.coverage: 150 tests in 30 files, including shell focus, focus-managed dialogs, restrained live regions, authority routing, semantic states, and exact-value alternatives.

E3.coverage: Focus contrast, every semantic status text token on white/parchment, and the 44 CSS pixel shared-control baseline.

E4.coverage: Map/Outline parity, full prerequisite closure, keyboard access, non-drag positioning, focus return, text spacing, forced colors, reduced motion, 320px reflow proxy, 200% text, small-height focus reachability, touch scroll, and axe.

E5.coverage: Skip link, route/drawer focus, no page overflow, keyboard-only mobile Session controls, six-viewport Analysis/Today/Activity/Session/replacement lifecycle, full cross-browser Session lifecycle, and recoverable error retry.

E6.coverage: Direction, branch hierarchy, current/target/Today/Unknown comprehension, focused prerequisite closure, meaningful collapse, and Map/Outline parity.

E7.result: Mixed: automated rows Passed; all unavailable real platform/assistive-technology rows Not executed
E7.coverage: Exact executed and unexecuted browser/platform/assistive-technology claims.

E8.source: frontend/e2e/security.spec.ts and the serialized production Playwright journey
E8.coverage: Production TLS/session behavior, timer persistence, authority routing, origin/host restrictions, backup/live-restore exclusion, offline restore, and restart.

responsive: 320 CSS pixel viewport as the 1280px/400% reflow proxy (native browser zoom was not executed)

evidence: The product contains no prerecorded audio or video content
instructions do not rely on sensory characteristics
text labels and icons accompany semantic colors
essential text is rendered as text
core actions do not depend on hover/focus popovers
no user-interface time limit; Today expiry is advisory and debt-free
no auto-updating animation; timer ticks are silent and state remains controllable
descriptive link names and surrounding context
Roadmap pan/zoom/reset and X/Y alternatives to gestures/drag
commands commit on click/up and destructive reset is confirmed
visible labels are included in accessible names
non-drag Roadmap positioning and viewport controls
44px product control targets; inline text-link exception only
focus does not trigger unexpected context change
form input does not submit or navigate implicitly
help is contextual and consistently located where present
labels and instructions on all inputs
recoverable validation guidance and retry paths
confirmation for state replacement; server-authoritative errors
same-process user input is retained across recoverable failures
restrained live-region tests for routes, Session transitions, and errors
